info.title: MonHex
info.author: dantton
info.description: Pokémon save editor and bank for
info.details:
A Pokémon save editor that runs on the Switch, in the spirit of PKSM on the 3DS. Edit your boxes, party and bag right on the console, no PC needed.

Supports Sword/Shield, Let's Go, Legends: Arceus, Scarlet/Violet and Legends: Z-A (FireRed/LeafGreen Switch release is experimental).

- Full Pokémon editor and Pokémon creation
- Move, clone, release, export and import (PKHeX/PKSM formats)
- Bag editor
- Bank shared across all games, with search
- Automatic backups before every save, with restore
- Works from the Album, no title override needed
- English, Portuguese, Spanish and French

Built on PKSM-Core by FlagBrew. MonHex does not check legality. Keep your own save backups.

AI use: Co-written with AI.
